title: Check if String Is Decomposable Into Value-Equal Substrings

approach: 分组统计连续字符长度，每组mod 3余0或余2，余2的恰好1组
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def isDecomposable(self, s: str) -> bool:
        two_count = 0
        i = 0
        while i < len(s):
            j = i
            while j < len(s) and s[j] == s[i]:
                j += 1
            length = j - i
            rem = length % 3
            if rem == 1: return False
            if rem == 2: two_count += 1
            if two_count > 1: return False
            i = j
        return two_count == 1

title: The Number of the Smallest Unoccupied Chair
key_insight: 用最小堆维护可用椅子和正在使用的椅子(按离开时间排序)
approach: 按到达时间排序，用最小堆管理空闲椅子，优先队列按离开时间释放椅子
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def smallestChair(self, times: List[List[int]], targetFriend: int) -> int:
        import heapq
        n = len(times)
        order = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: times[i][0])
        available = list(range(n))
        heapq.heapify(available)
        used = []  # (leave_time, chair)
        for i in order:
            arrive, leave = times[i]
            while used and used[0][0] <= arrive:
                _, chair = heapq.heappop(used)
                heapq.heappush(available, chair)
            chair = heapq.heappop(available)
            if i == targetFriend:
                return chair
            heapq.heappush(used, (leave, chair))
        return -1

code_python3:
class Solution:
    def minNonZeroProduct(self, p: int) -> int:
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        mx = (1 << p) - 1
        half = mx - 1
        cnt = (1 << (p - 1)) - 1
        return mx % MOD * pow(half % MOD, cnt, MOD) % MOD

key_insight: Dijkstra求最短路的同时计算到达终点的最短路径数
approach: Dijkstra松弛时同时维护路径数：相等距离则累加，更短距离则重置
code_python3:
class Solution:
    def countPaths(self, n: int, roads: List[List[int]]) -> int:
        import heapq
        from collections import defaultdict
        MOD = 10**9 + 7
        graph = defaultdict(list)
        for u, v, w in roads:
            graph[u].append((v, w))
            graph[v].append((u, w))
        dist = [float('inf')] * n
        ways = [0] * n
        dist[0] = 0
        ways[0] = 1
        pq = [(0, 0)]
        while pq:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(pq)
            if d > dist[u]: continue
            for v, w in graph[u]:
                if d + w < dist[v]:
                    dist[v] = d + w
                    ways[v] = ways[u]
                    heapq.heappush(pq, (dist[v], v))
                elif d + w == dist[v]:
                    ways[v] = (ways[v] + ways[u]) % MOD
        return ways[n-1] % MOD
